shots.detail_en: close-up, the 联华实业 intraday chart climbing a red staircase on the board, CH's account number ticking upward reflected in his glasses
shots.sub: 一个星期，三成仓，翻了一倍半。这口气，我等了十年。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: wide shot, the hall cheering as the board stays red, MANCANG hugging his bankbook with happy tears amid the crowd
shots.sub: 翻倍了！闺女的嫁妆翻倍了！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: following shot, RED with a reporter's microphone weaving through the celebrating crowd toward CH, press badge swinging
shots.sub: 观众朋友们，散户大厅今天出了个新人。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: medium shot, RED blocking CH's way with her microphone, CH shaking his head and sidestepping past
shots.sub: 昨天底部全仓的，是不是您？您怎么看联华实业？
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: medium shot, MANCANG grabbing the microphone to brag, RED giving him a skeptical once-over
shots.sub: 他就是股神！我是他唯一的合伙人——
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: medium shot in a dark VIP office, XIONG studying a stack of CH's buy-order records under a desk lamp
shots.sub: 每次都在我砸出来的坑底。一次不差。
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: medium shot, XIONGWEI stepping in to suggest digging into CH's background
shots.sub: 爹，要不要我查查他的底细？
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: extreme close-up, XIONG's thumb rubbing the edge of the same old photograph from years ago, unreadable face
slow following shot at night in CH's tiny rented room, an old fan spinning, CH laying out his father's notebook under the lamp
shots.sub: 父亲留下的，不只是笔记本。还有一页，被人撕掉的答案。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: close-up, CH penciling his own reading onto the missing line of the notebook's last page
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: wide shot, the board flashing a suspension review announcement for 联华实业, the crowd erupting in uproar
shots.speaker: 散户群

shots.detail_en: medium shot, the broker leaning in to whisper to CH, both glancing around the hall
shots.sub: 有人调了你的开户底档。
shots.speaker: 经纪（画外）

shots.detail_en: flashback insert, a rainy 1993 night: BOY kneeling before an old CRT television, a young FATHER appearing on the snowy broadcast screen, flickering scanlines
shots.fx: 老电视雪花噪+磁带倒带

shots.detail_en: close-up back in the present, CH gripping his pocket watch, eyes going cold
slow push on the VIP tea room, XIONG pouring tea with steady hands, steam rising, CH entering the frame
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: medium two-shot across the tea table, CH and XIONG facing each other, XIONG setting down the pot
shots.sub: 你的买点，是家传的，还是偷师的？
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: close two-shot, CH answering without blinking, XIONG's smile fading a degree
shots.sub: 都不是。是您教的——您每砸一次盘，就亮一次底牌。
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: medium shot, XIONG laughing softly and sliding the tea cup across the table toward CH
shots.speaker: 熊

shots.detail_en: medium shot, CH setting the untouched cup down and standing up from the tea table
shots.sub: 我只是个清洁工。扫地，不接盘。
shots.speaker: 长

shots.detail_en: wide shot, XIONGWEI handing over a dossier, XIONG raising a hand to cut him off, gazing at the city through the blinds
shots.sub: 陆长虹，1993 年 6 月……够了。
shots.speaker: 熊伟、熊

shots.card: 十年前的电视里，他说过什么？
